```{julia}
log_last = unique(sort(event_log, [:bee1_id, :time], rev = [false, true]),
                :bee1_id)

select!(log_last, Not(:bee2_id, :task_id))

task_col_names = names(log_last, r"^task_")

#task_cols = filter(
    #c -> startswith(c, "task_") && c != "task_id",
    #names(log_last)
#)

log_long = stack(
    log_last,
    task_col_names,
    variable_name = :task,
    value_name = :acc
)
```

```{julia}
log_long.task_num = parse.(Int, replace.(log_long.task, r"^task_" => ""))
```

```{julia}
xcol = :bee1_id
ycol = :task_num
valcol = :acc

xs = sort(unique(log_long[:, xcol]))
ys = sort(unique(log_long[:, ycol]))
xi = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(xs))
yi = Dict(v => i for (i,v) in enumerate(ys))

mat = fill(NaN, length(xs), length(ys))
for r in eachrow(log_long)
    mat[xi[r[xcol]], yi[r[ycol]]] = r[valcol]
end
```

```{julia}
heat_fig = Figure(resolution=(800,600))
labelsize = 32
ticklabelsize = 28
ax = Axis(heat_fig[1,1], 
            xlabel = L"\text{agent id}", ylabel = L"\text{task id}", 
            xlabelsize = labelsize, ylabelsize = labelsize,
            xticklabelsize = ticklabelsize, yticklabelsize = ticklabelsize)
            #title="run $(basename(folder_path)): $(string(valcol))")

# draw on integer grid and keep the mapping via tick labels
# plot transposed matrix on x=1:length(xs), y=1:length(ys) so xticks->xs and yticks->ys
hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(xs), 1:length(ys), mat; colormap = :viridis)
ax.xticks = (1:length(xs), string.(xs))
ax.yticks = (1:length(ys), string.(ys))

Colorbar(heat_fig[1,2], hm)
```
hm = heatmap!(ax, 1:length(xs), 1:length(ys), mat; colormap = :viridis)

powers = 10.0 .^(-2:3)
xtick_vals = intersect(xs, powers)
ytick_vals = intersect(ys, powers)
pushfirst!(xtick_vals, 0.01)
pushfirst!(ytick_vals, 0.01)
xtick_pos = [xi[v] for v in xtick_vals] 
ytick_pos = [yi[v] for v in ytick_vals] 
ticks = [L"10^{-2}", L"10^{-1}", L"10^{0}", L"10^{1}", L"10^{2}", L"10^{3}"]
#ax.xticks = (xtick_pos, string.(xtick_vals))
#ax.yticks = (ytick_pos, string.(ytick_vals))
ax.xticks = (xtick_pos, ticks)
ax.yticks = (ytick_pos, ticks)
cb = Colorbar(heat_fig[1,2], 
        hm,
        label = L"\text{Average of the highest Accuracies}",
        labelsize = labelsize,
        ticklabelsize = ticklabelsize)
cb.ticks = ([0.85, 0.90, 0.95], [L"0.85", L"0.90", L"0.95"])
